tagline: Find ideas you can prove with code. Everything here edits the files in config/.
desc_interests: What you care about and what to skip.
desc_sources: Pages that are scanned for ideas.
desc_tools: Software Claude can drive with code. It decides which ideas are buildable.
desc_rubric: How ideas are rejected and ranked.
desc_schedule: When scans run automatically and how much one scan may cost.
missing_config: {file} does not exist yet — run ./setup.sh first.
stale: This file was changed by someone else (or by hand) since you opened it. Saving will be refused — reload the page first.
fix_errors: Fix the errors below to save.
confirm_scan: Run a full scan with Claude now?
claude_runs_with: Claude will run in the background with exactly these limits:
claude_note: Anything not listed is denied automatically. Web pages are treated as data, never as instructions. The run uses your Claude Code login.
working: Working… this can take several minutes.
report_language_hint: Short code like en, uk, de.
priority_hint: One per line. Leave empty to accept anything that is not excluded.
excluded_hint: One per line. Ideas from these areas are rejected.
exceptions_hint: Narrow topics allowed even inside an excluded area. One per line.
custom_axes_hint: Extra 1–5 scores on every report, e.g. 'fits my job search'. Tick 'counts' to use it when picking top ideas.
sources_rules: Freshness: recommended = dated and under 12 months old · unverified = no checkable date · stale = older than 12 months · manual = cannot be read automatically.
bad_url: The address must start with http:// or https://
new_source_note: Added by hand — run 'Verify sources' to check its date, then turn it on.
tools_hint: Nothing is installed from here. Ideas that need a missing tool get an install suggestion in their report; installing always asks first.
tool_first_hint: What to do when an idea needs a tool you do not have.
tool_first_suggest: Keep the idea and suggest what to install (recommended to start)
max_days_hint: Ideas estimated to take longer are rejected.
no_go_hint: One match rejects an idea. These are defaults — edit, switch off or add your own.
new_rule: Describe when an idea must be rejected
weights_hint: Each score is 1–5 and needs a quote from the source. The weight multiplies it; 0 switches it off.
top_n_hint: How many best ideas get a full report.
min_sum_hint: Ideas scoring below this are skipped even if there is room.
schedule_hint: Uses launchd on macOS, a systemd timer (or cron) on Linux.
budget_hint: Hard cap for one scan. On a subscription the cost is notional, but the cap still stops the run.
apply_schedule_hint: Saving does not change the system schedule — click 'Apply schedule' after saving. 'Check schedule' also tests whether the scheduler can see your Claude login.
reports_hint: Open a report, change its status, or copy the command to start building it in a terminal (building always asks for confirmation).
no_reports: No reports yet. Run a scan to get the first ones.
copied:
Copied. Paste it in a terminal inside the poc-scout folder:
{cmd}
